servinfo.title: Gear Shift Control Lever and Cable Removal and Installation

ptxt.intxrefpoff: Gear Shift Control Lever and Cable Components

attention2.ptxt: Touching a hot exhaust system component will cause a burn.
Do not perform any service work on the select cable until the exhaust system is cool.

s1.ptxt: Remove gear shift control lever knob, if necessary.
Remove shift control lever boot, if necessary.
Remove floor console box front bracket.
Disconnect end (1) of gear shift control cable from pivot (2) of gear shift control lever assembly (3).
Disconnect end (4) of gear select control cable from pivot (5) of gear shift control lever assembly.
Disconnect gear shift and gear select control cables (6) from gear shift control lever assembly while pulling quick joint (7) in arrow direction as shown in figure.
Remove gear shift control lever assembly mounting nuts (8) and remove gear shift control lever assembly from floor panel.
Disconnect gear shift and gear select control cables from transaxle while puling up quick joint (1) in arrow direction.
Remove cable grommet bolts (2) and cable nuts (3), and then remove gear shift and select control cables from floor panel.

servinfosub.title: Installation
servinfosub.ptxt: Reverse removal procedure noting the following points.

item.ptxt: Apply grease to pivot of gear shift and select shaft assembly and gear shift control lever.
Tighten each bolt and nut to specified torque.
Install gear shift control lever boot (1), if removed, fixing it to gear shift lever (3) with O ring (2) as shown and then turn it over in arrow direction.
Apply sealant to thread part (1) of gear shift control lever assembly and install new gear shift control lever knob, if removed.
